name: Educational
looksLike: a site with lessons and courses to study
a website showing learning modules and progress
an online place to work through a course
definition: A website that organizes learning material into courses, lessons, or guided paths and helps learners understand prerequisites, track progress, and continue studying.
goal: Help learners choose suitable material and progress through it.
audience: People learning a subject or skill

sections.name: Learning path
sections.purpose: Show lessons in an understandable order.

sections.name: Lesson workspace
sections.purpose: Present instructions, examples, and practice clearly.

sections.name: Progress and next steps
sections.purpose: Show completion and a clear route to continue.

mustHave: Progress that does not rely on color alone

prompts.short: Build a learning site with course discovery, ordered lessons, accessible material, and progress indicators.
prompts.detailed: Build a educational website for people learning a subject or skill. Help learners choose suitable material and progress through it. Include course discovery, learning path, lesson workspace, progress and next steps. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Clear outcomes and prerequisites.
